No, like I said it pretty much happens with every avatar. 

I've noticed in VR that sometimes the eye tracking makes the eyes look to the side and squint like shifty eyes or something. Another cause for the same issue, it makes the eyes blink slightly which messes with closed-eyes expressions.

details:
Pitching the head up and down causes partial activation of the blink and lowerlid blend shapes to partially activate. This causes a common problem where the eyelids partially go through each other when the eyes are closed by a gesture. I am not talking about the eyes blinking when they're closed, this is a different issue. Usually the effect is subtle but sometimes it's not and it can be pretty annoying. It's very obvious when you go looking for it. Please refer to this short clip where I have an avatar where the effect is unfortunately not so subtle. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UPOJ258Ydjw

The first avatar uses standard visemes and blinking/winking animations with empty lowerlid blend shapes. The second avatar is edited to exaggerate the effect, with Ah/Ch for Blink Left/Right and Glasses 1/2 (different pairs of glasses come from inside the head) for Lowerlid Left/Right, and without dynamic bones. Both have FBT fixes for the hip and neck, but I have checked an older model without FBT fixes/hacks (specifically - https://vrcmods.com/item/944-Yuno-Gasai-black-dress) and the same issue occurs. Anyway, you can see that the mouth opens when the head pitches up, and the glasses come out when the head pitches down. I'm not activating any gestures except eyes closed the whole time in the first avatar. There's an obvious link between the pitch of the head and the blend shapes. I'm not sure what is happening with the eyes, that might just be caused by updating the eye bones without resetting the rig in unity or something. In most of my tests the eyes didn't look behave like that but the blinking issue is the same either way. 

It's not just this model or FBT hacks. You can see this effect on pretty much any avatar but usually it's more subtle. I've also tested on the new FBT beta and still see the same behavior.
title: Blinking animations tied to rig motion
